decisive_spans.text: A skeletal survey revealed diffuse osteosclerosis, biconvex vertebrae, a wide open anterior fontanel with Wormian bones, and acro-osteolysis of the distal phalanges

response.rationale: D2 (Pyknodysostosis) is strongly supported by the presence of diffuse osteosclerosis, biconvex vertebrae, a wide open anterior fontanel with Wormian bones, and acro-osteolysis of the distal phalanges, which are all classic features of this condition. D1 (Pycnodysostosis-like syndrome) is a broader category and while it shares some features, D2 is a more specific and accurate diagnosis given the comprehensive skeletal findings.
